headline: BTC Pipeline Transports 21.1 Million Tonnes of Crude Oil in Jan-Oct
summary: The Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan (BTC) pipeline transported 21.104 million tonnes of crude oil from January through October 2026. Volumes declined 7.3% compared to the same period in 2025.
why: The Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan pipeline is a strategic energy export route transporting Caspian oil to Mediterranean shipping terminals.

impacts.name: Azerbaijan
impacts.why: Caspian crude oil pipeline throughput dropped 7.3% year-over-year during the ten-month period.
